user.title: 1/4 · Destination and distance
user.description: Choose the entity representing your destination and how far to search for parking. Other settings come next.

data_description.destination_entity: Only compatible entities are pre-listed. Expected attributes: latitude + longitude, or lat + lon/lng. Example: latitude 50.9385, longitude 6.9829.

categories.title: 2/4 · Parking types
categories.description: Select one or more parking categories and the maximum results per category. You can also include restricted/private parking.

providers.title: 3/4 · Additional providers
providers.description: OpenStreetMap and key-free municipal sources work automatically. Select any extra providers that require API credentials (many offer free developer keys). Select none to finish without a credentials step.

credentials.title: 4/4 · API credentials
credentials.description: Enter credentials for: {selected_providers}. Previously saved keys are kept when their fields are left blank and are never displayed.

data_description.golemio_api_key: Optional free developer key from api.golemio.cz/api-keys. Used only for destinations in Prague.
data_description.tfnsw_api_key: Optional Transport for NSW Open Data API key. Used only for destinations in NSW.
data_description.tdx_client_id: Optional TDX Client ID from the TDX member center. Client ID and Client Secret are both required.
data_description.tdx_client_secret: Optional TDX Client Secret. It is stored in the Home Assistant config entry and redacted from diagnostics.
data_description.ura_access_key: Optional access key from the official URA API portal. URA uses it to issue a daily token. The key is stored securely in your Home Assistant config entry and redacted from diagnostics.

error.invalid_destination_entity: The selected entity is unavailable or does not currently expose valid coordinates.
error.no_parking_types: Select at least one parking type.
error.invalid_provider_selection: Choose only providers from the list.
error.invalid_radius: Distance must be between 100 and 10,000 metres.
error.invalid_max_results: Maximum suggestions must be between 1 and 25.
error.missing_credentials: Enter the missing credential (or disable its provider).

abort.already_configured: This destination entity is already configured.

options.ura: Enable Singapore URA car parks (requires access key)

find_parking.name: Find parking
find_parking.description: Search parking around coordinates and return a structured list without changing the configured destination or sensor state.

radius_m.name: Search radius
radius_m.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the selected OSM Parking configuration.

parking_types.name: Parking types
parking_types.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the parking types enabled in the selected configuration.

max_results.name: Maximum results per category
max_results.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the configured per-category limit.

include_restricted.name: Include restricted/private parking
include_restricted.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the configured setting.

config_entry_id.name: OSM Parking configuration
config_entry_id.description: Provider settings and API credentials to use. Leave empty when exactly one OSM Parking configuration is loaded.

action_entry_not_found.message: The selected OSM Parking configuration does not exist.

action_entry_not_loaded.message: The selected OSM Parking configuration is not loaded.

action_no_loaded_entry.message: No loaded OSM Parking configuration is available.

action_multiple_loaded_entries.message: More than one OSM Parking configuration is loaded. Select one in Provider settings.

action_invalid_search_options.message: The parking search options are invalid.

action_search_failed.message: Parking data could not be retrieved from any usable source.
